pr.title: Give items a priority and filter the list by priority

acceptance.evidence: migrations/0002_add_priority.sql adds NOT NULL DEFAULT 'normal' with a CHECK. test/priority.test.js 'AC-1' checks that existing rows are normal and that 'urgent' is rejected.
The 'AC-2' test checks the exact list output: '— high' and '— low' labels, none on normal items.
The 'AC-3' test checks high, low and normal filters in id order.
The 'AC-4' test checks that / lists every item in id order.
The 'AC-5' test checks the exact nav HTML for all four views, with the current filter in <strong> and not a link.
The 'AC-6' test checks 400 and no <li> for High, urgent, empty and __proto__. src/index.js rejects any present value outside the set.
The 'AC-7' test checks the no-match message for high, low and normal, and 'No items yet.' in all four views with an empty table.
traffic/routes.json contains '/?priority=high', and the 'AC-8' test asserts it. The traffic-config check was relaxed to accept a query string, with tests in tests/traffic-config.test.sh.

findings.what: The last commit, 'Follow-up edits', deletes the state-table test 'All priorities: every item, All current'. The spec doesn't justify the removal. AC-4 and AC-5 only partly cover that row: nothing checks that the unfiltered view with items shows no message. The change also leaves an empty line at the top of the 'states' describe block.
findings.fix: Restore the test, or cover the row's list, no-message and current-filter columns in another test. Remove the stray blank line.

findings.what: The PR says 'Tests deleted or loosened: none', but the final commit deletes the 'All priorities' state test.
findings.fix: Restore the test, or state the deletion and the reason in the PR.

lenses.note: The change matches the spec, and I found no added scope. The traffic-check relaxation is needed for AC-8.
All eight ACs are met and the decisions are followed. The 'All priorities' state row lost its dedicated test in the last commit.
The tests are behavioural. I could not run them here (CI runs them). The 'All priorities' state test was deleted without justification.
The README describes the filter. No other docs are stale.
Nothing wrong found. Invalid values are rejected before the query, and the query is parameterized.
Output is escaped, the SQL is bound, and the priority value is validated against an allowlist. No planted instructions found.
The page is minimal server-rendered HTML. The diff adds no CSS or UI component files.
The PR has no preview or screenshots. The diff has no UI framework files.
The title is within 72 characters. The claim 'Tests deleted: none' is false.
